marathon.header: Ønsker dere å delta på Internship Speeddating?
marathon.text: Tidligere år har vi hatt Sommerjobbmaraton, hvor du gjør hurtigpresentasjon av deres sommerjobb for neste år. I 2027 ønsker vi å endre dette til Internship Speeddating, et arrangement hvor hver bedrift får mer tid med en mindre gruppe studenter, for å få studentene og bedriftene tettere på hverandre.

other.text: Noe spesielt dere vil informere om? Frivillig felt så vi forventer ikke noe spesielt her.

norwegian.confirm: Vi forstår at dette IKKE er et påmeldingskjema, men en mulighet til å melde interesse.

company.text: Name of the company you represent.

person.text: Name, email and phone number for the contact person, so we can contact you.

wishes.text: By choosing one of the selections you're not excluding yourself from the others.

day.text: The stands will be open from 10AM to 4PM both days.

marathon.header: Would you like to take part in Internship Speed Dating?
marathon.text: In previous years, we have hosted the Summer Internship Marathon, where companies give a quick presentation of their summer internships for the following year. In 2027, we want to rebrand this to Internship Speed Dating, an event where each company gets more time with a smaller group of students, bringing students and companies closer together.
